text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Ever since I was a little girl,
I loved going to Tomakomai Port.
It was so cool to see the huge ships
approaching the 
massive port as if they were breaking the
sea.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
The wide surface of Lake Utonai,
reflecting the sky, is also 
beautiful.…… I always lose track of time
when I see the migratory 
birds relaxing there.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
The people in town are nice and when I went
to visit them, they 
brought me freshly made haskap jam.…… There
are many parks. I 
remember playing there all day long.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
It is a…… very, very nice town. But still,
more and more stores 
are closing their shutters little by
little……

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
That is Tomakomai City.…… is my dear
hometown.

text_block_list.name: Haskap Farm Owner
text_block_list.text:
―When I heard that she was going to live in
the country by herself,
I couldn't help but do something about it.
I made a 
business card for Tarumae-chan.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: What? A business card?

text_block_list.name: Haskap Farm Owner
text_block_list.text:
What Tarumae-chan is striving for is to
connect with people. 
You need to find many people who can help
you.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much……! I will treasure it!
You gave me so many 
haskaps,
and you even made me a business card……!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
……I also received a tusk from everyone 
at yesterday's farewell party……

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I'll do my best! 
I will definitely make Tomakomai more
exciting!

One day,
some time after arriving at Tracen Academy,
I saw a 
small crowd of people in front of the train
station.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Tomakomai, the white earth,
the paper dances 
Oh, Tomakomai,
the migratory birds have a good night ……♪

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
…… That's all, it was "Come on,
Tomakomai" 
written and composed by Hokko Tarumae～!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Thank you♪ 
Tokyo is so warm to have people stop by like
this.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Once again―a paper winged migratory bird
from 
the port of Tomakomai! I love hokki-gai☆ 
I am Tomakomai's locodol, Hokko Tarumae♪

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Actually,
I just came to Tracen Academy this 
spring,
so I still don't know much. Hehe.
Nice to meet you.

I don't know if there was ever a girl on
campus with that 
kind of vibe……? I wonder,
and somehow stop in my tracks.

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text:
You are a good singer.
Her atmosphere is pure and cute. It 
will be a good healing for my holiday.

And now people are waiting for the next song,
whether they 
realize it or not. It began―

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Well, next up is the…… Tomakomai Quiz!
The Yufutsu River, a 
second class river,
flows through Tomakomai! What is the 
name of the main stream that joins it?

text_block_list.name: Passersby
text_block_list.text: …… What?
It was a quiz competition.
And after that―

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Next,
we will learn about the history of
Tomakomai♪ 
Tomakomai was settled in the Meiji Era…

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
The resources of abundant water and
plentiful 
forests led to the development of the paper
industry. 
Tomakomai produces a lot of newsprint!

text_block_list.name: Passerby B
text_block_list.text: I… I see……?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Next,
we should learn about Tomakomai's specialties.
I've 
compiled a list of recommended stores in
this booklet.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
More and more stores are offering frozen
delivery, so everyone 
can buy one. So,
each one of you can take one home!

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text:
Oh, um, you don't sing anymore? I was 
thinking I'd like to hear some more……

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Um…… sorry! I don't have any more songs ready!
But! Instead, 
we're having a Tomakomai haskap tasting
right now!

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text: Ta… tasting event?…… I see.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I love these haskaps. They bring me so much,
but this is 
the last one because I love them so much.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I hope you guys like it too!
Here's one for you!

I take the haskap as prompted and throw it
into my mouth. 
It is fresh and tart with a hint of
sweetness.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I know,
right? It's also great as a jam.
Everyone else too…

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Eh, what! Everyone is gone……! 
Ah, I did it again ……

The live music success…… but after the
tasting event, 
the event ended with an indescribable
atmosphere.

The singing was lovely,
she always tried her 
best to liven up the place,
and the haskaps 
were excellent, but… the world is harsh.
A few days later―

I cannot forget the taste of the haskaps I
had at a tasting the 
other day. But apparently,
they are hard to find in 
supermarkets in Honshu.

When I opened the booklet that Hokko Tarumae
gave me, 
I found the contact information for the
store that sold the 
haskap that I had eaten at the tasting was
clearly listed.

text_block_list.name: Haskap Farm Owner
text_block_list.text:
『Well, well,
well! Tarumae-chan live on the street!
She's 
really working hard, isn't she?』

text_block_list.name: Haskap Farm Owner
text_block_list.text:
『……How was she? She's a serious girl, 
so I was kind of worried.'』
choice_data_list: It was a trial and error situation.

text_block_list.name: Haskap Farm Owner
text_block_list.text:
『I see.……She is working really hard to
achieve her dreams.』

text_block_list.name: Haskap Farm Owner
text_block_list.text:
『We can't lose either. Actually,
she's inspired us so much 
that we've recently started working on social
media.』

text_block_list.name: Haskap Farm Owner
text_block_list.text:
『Ah, I'm sorry, I'm rambling on and on. 
A box of haskaps right?.』

The haskaps that arrived at a later date
did indeed 
taste fresh and had a…… "10% off" ticket in
it.
